name: Museu de História Natural (Natural History Museum)
subtitle: A natural history museum run by Eduardo Mondlane University, in a Manueline-style building.

facts.label: Building
facts.value: Housed in a Manueline-style building since 1933.

facts.label: Founding
facts.value: UEM page says established in 1911 (another UEM page, not readable, reportedly says 1913; unresolved).

facts.label: Collection
facts.value: Elephant foetuses from one to 22 months of development.

parts.text: A natural history museum run by Eduardo Mondlane University, in a Manueline-style building. Its best-known exhibit is a collection of elephant foetuses.
